items.title: CDSL Q4 Results: Cons PAT declines 20% to Rs 80 crore, Rs 12.75/share dividend declared
items.description: CDSL Q4 Results: Central Depository Services Limited reported a mixed Q4 FY26 performance, with revenue growing 17.1% to Rs 262.85 crore, but net profit declining 20% to Rs 80.22 crore. The company surpassed 18 crore demat accounts, highlighting growing investor trust despite profitability pressures. Full-year net profit for FY26 also saw a 14% decrease.

items.title: Kotak Mahindra Bank Q4 Results: PAT jumps 13% to Rs 4,026.55 crore, NII rises 8%
items.description: Kotak Mahindra Bank Q4 Results: Kotak Mahindra Bank on Saturday reported a net profit of Rs 4,026.55 crore for the March quarter of FY26, marking a jump of 13.3% from Rs 3,552 crore posted in the corresponding quarter of the previous financial year.

items.title: DMart Q4 Results: Avenue Supermarts cons PAT jumps 19% to Rs 656 crore, revenue too rises 19%
items.description: DMart Q4 Results: Avenue Supermarts, the operator of DMart, on Saturday reported a net profit of Rs 656.6 crore for the March quarter of FY26, marking a jump of 19% from Rs 550.90 crore posted in the corresponding quarter of the previous financial year. The net profit is attributable to the equity holders of the company.
